name: S P Setia Berhad
summary: S P Setia Berhad, an investment holding company, operates as a property development and investment company in Malaysia, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam, the United Kingdom, and Japan. The company operates in two segments, Property Development; and Construction, Investment Holding & Others. It develops bungalow, high-rise, terrace, semi-detached, cluster, and townhouse, as well as commercial, retail, and industrial properties.
